scope: CHANNEL events, engagement tasks, explicit progress reads and current-wallet check-in/wallet-connect actions

prd.requirement: Follow event list/detail and points website fields and buttons; all event types retained

source.runtime_origin: https://api.vanta.exchange/api/; runtime /points-api/ rewrite verified in points-public-contract.json

models.type: Distinct RETAIL/CHANNEL, exact positive IDs, source channelName/allowlist count; omit whitelist address arrays and administrative fields
models.new_user: Published registration/wallet/deposit rewards, exact net deposit amount/token and optional chain; observed public source omits chainId, no guessed chain
models.daily: UTC server date, checked flag, checked dates, exact target and daily volume. Missing amounts/flags stay unknown; calendar/duplicates/future dates/flag inconsistencies rejected
models.milestones: Published ordered unique thresholds/descriptions/rewards/trackMetric, optional server current/completed/remaining; never infer paid rewards
models.other_metrics: ownVolume; own+network only when both known; qualifiedInviteeCount; networkActiveTraderCount; whitelistTotalVolume; per-chain-token depositProgress. Decimal/integers, no double amount arithmetic
models.rankings: CHANNEL channel-volume top10; RETAIL retail-volume top30; exact event/type binding, server order/ties retained, no own-volume re-ranking or guessed outside rank

progress.evidence: Public frontend source only. No actual address-bearing endpoint requested; test fixtures are synthetic. Echoed eventId/address validated when supplied.
progress.transport: Fixed anonymous GET; application/json, no redirects/credentials, 2 MiB streamed bound, exact numeric decoder, 12 second timeout with abort; service disposal aborts active task reads
progress.privacy: No personal reads on entry/background resume. User explicitly refreshes participation and task progress. Wallet identity/address/kind changes clear progress; stale/failed/paused/stop/late result handled independently.

wallet_connect.eligibility: Active event time and status, registered participant, server newUser.completeRegistration.completed=true and connectWallet.completed=false

check_in.eligibility: Active event time/status, registered, matching current UTC server day, explicit checkedInToday=false and day absent from checkedInDates, known server volume>=known server target

actions.signer: Existing selected wallet personal_sign through WalletMessageSigner; connected EOA remains signer, existing Privy wallet allowed, no new wallet or Privy token substitution
actions.approval: Independent native confirmation with event/wallet/action and check-in UTC date; new event+participant+task reads before and after signing, complete published terms fingerprint, identity/disposal/date checks across awaits
actions.local_time_policy: Signature age0..120000ms; local defensive bound, not an official server TTL. UTC day, signature age and event end checked again after journal write before sending.
actions.execution: One POST, no redirect/retry; transport abort on12s timeout/disposal; 2xx acknowledgement only, response body not used as evidence. Original scoped task progress must prove completion.

recovery.storage: SharedPreferencesAsync vanta.eventEngagement.pending.v1. Serialized acknowledged writes; only public eventId/address/action/original UTC day, never signature/token/raw response. Persist before POST.
recovery.bounds: 100 unresolved entries /65536 characters; malformed/corrupt/duplicate records fail closed, no eviction or silent reset
recovery.scope: Any unresolved entry blocks both actions for same event/wallet across screens/repository reconstruction; other wallet entries retained
recovery.reconcile: Explicit task GET; walletCompleted=true or original check-in date in checkedInDates proves completion and permits removal. False/missing/current balance/HTTP status alone never clears unknown. Old-day check-in uses original day, not today.
recovery.known_unsent: Scope/expiry changes detected immediately after journal write remove known-unsent marker; deletion failure retains unknown
recovery.limits: SharedPreferences acknowledgement and synthetic storage reconstruction are not OS power-loss/kill guarantees; no recovery after app-data deletion/uninstall. No official pending-request lookup; missing/false progress can keep unknown blocked indefinitely.

ui: Points -> events -> Retail/Channel chips -> fresh detail; published source text/rules/rewards remain source content; app strings bilingual. Channel task cards show unknown explicitly, date/history and milestones; current-address copy and same-wallet action confirmation. Published ACTIVE with elapsed end is shown ended in list and cannot submit; detail retains published status plus computed end. Campaign deposits/trading/referrals open exact Vanta Orderly website paths, never Aster funding/trading. Completion is not reward payment.
remaining: Actual task response schema and signature acceptance remain source-only plus synthetic tests; no real personal endpoint or action POST
Native TLS/image/layout/accessibility/wallet return/refusal/background/kill recovery and iOS unverified
AI, full cross-product Portfolio, collateral contribution/Swap and other PRD gaps remain; BAPI statistics/TWAP skipped by user
